shardRule: sha256(familyId) modulo 3, over the full hex digest

shardRuleRecomputed.note: Recomputed independently over all 61 correction_required family ids in correction-index.json. Shard 0, 1 and 2 memberships reproduce the published review-shards.json exactly, with no disagreement.

scope: only the 8 correction_required families assigned to shard 2

strictLimits.basis: Verified independently rather than from corrections-audit.json: diffed each of the seven correction branches against its own pre-correction lane head over data/rcap-all50/overlays/production/ and mapped every changed family directory back to a family id. Exactly 48 correction_required families changed; 0 of the 104 technical_approved and 0 of the 88 held_on_source_or_design families were touched, so neither preserved set needed review.

findings.fieldOrRegion: protectedFieldsRefused / refusedFields counters, and fixtures/negative.json refusedFields[]
findings.visibleDefect: The re-render satisfies its acceptance condition, but the same census narrowing that fixes it also blinds the family's two independent refusal-evidence artifacts. reports/protected-fields-scan.json now reports protectedFieldsRefused 0 (was 4) and refusedFields 0, while still emitting pass true; fixtures/negative.json now enumerates an empty refusedFields[]. Cause: d1b-regenerate.mjs filters every lane-refused field out of the census before finalizeOfficialForm, so D0's binder and its scan never evaluate those fields and have nothing to report. The scan's writtenFields did drop by exactly 1, the withheld count, so the counter that matters for this correction is accurate. No artifact defect follows: this reviewer checked every refused field's own widget rectangle in canonical and boundary bytes directly and found all of them blank. The loss is that D0 no longer independently corroborates the lane's refusals -- the evidence is now the lane's own production-field-map.json assertion alone, and a future binder regression on a protected field would not be caught by this scan.
findings.likelyOwner: shared factory / cycle design (D0), not lane D1B: the lane implemented the fix the correction index prescribed verbatim, including the exact renderCensus filter expression, and lane D1A -- reviewed and approved -- carries the identical construction and the identical consequence
findings.acceptanceCondition: A future cycle should let the renderer keep deciding every field while honouring the lane's refusals, so D0's scan still evaluates and reports them -- for example by passing the full census together with an explicit refusal set rather than a pre-filtered census, so protected-fields-scan.json again reports a non-zero protectedFieldsRefused and negative.json again enumerates refusedFields. Until then protected-fields-scan.json must not be read as evidence that protected fields were evaluated. This needs the same kind of scope decision as the two D0 defects this cycle declined to widen into.
findings.evidenceBasis: Read protected-fields-scan.json and fixtures/negative.json at both the pre-correction lane head 21f5c446d234b69e00a08dffa1c2d79e0cd7b186 and the correction branch head; diffed reports/overflow-and-clipping.json and negative.json entry-by-entry and confirmed every dropped entry names a field the lane's own bindingRefusals still records, with zero non-lane-refused entries dropped and the substantive overflow findings preserved exactly; read the renderCensus diff in scripts/rcap-official-forms/lanes/d1b-regenerate.mjs; and re-ran the lane, whose own protectedRefused counter still reports 317 across VA/KY/NC, showing the refusal decisions still happen in the lane and only D0's view of them was lost.

families.rationale: The family-specific defect is fixed and independently verified against the PDF bytes. This reviewer rebuilt the withheld-field detector from scratch -- source AcroForm widget census by fully-qualified name, then text extracted from page content at each widget's own rectangle -- and it reproduces exactly 1 leaks on the pre-correction bytes, matching this family's recorded correction count, and 0 on the corrected bytes across canonical and boundary. Widening the same test to all 1 withheld fields and every other lane-refused field found no value written at any refused rectangle in either fixture, protected-category fields included. Nothing legitimate was lost: every character the untouched source's page content draws survives into both fixtures, page count, order and geometry are preserved, and every bound participant value is still visible at its own rectangle. No print-flag ink leak: every non-printing widget rectangle carries only what the source itself prints there or what an overlapping printing widget covers. The artifacts and the contact sheet are fully inspectable with no object streams and no encryption, and an independent scan of the materialised object model plus every decompressed stream found no XFA, JavaScript, field or document /AA, OpenAction, Launch, SubmitForm, ImportData or URI -- against 16 such objects in the pre-correction contact sheet, so defect B cleaned this family too even though a sheet defect was never recorded against it. Determinism was verified first hand rather than read off a report: re-running the lane from the verified source pack in a detached worktree reproduced all three artifacts byte-identically. Currentness and legal-design holds are unchanged. One moderate finding is recorded against the refusal-evidence artifacts; it is a consequence of the fix the correction index prescribed, it does not affect the artifacts, and it is owned by D0 rather than this lane. technical_approved is a technical-track disposition only -- this family still carries its visual-review, runtime and generation holds.

findings.fieldOrRegion: sanitizeAndFlatten -> form.updateFieldAppearances(); AcroForm text fields 'Other Defendants' and 'Address at Time of Arrest'
findings.visibleDefect: Unchanged this cycle, as expected, and still produces no artifact at all. Reproduced first hand in this session against the verified source binary (sha256 7c527bf351e9ab08658f901abc9be15e12e5beb2afe7ded14a8c5e2f0d6eb641, matching the D3 pack bytes): loading the source and calling sanitizeAndFlatten throws 'Reading rich text fields is not supported: Attempted to read rich text field: Other Defendants'. The family directory carries no fixtures/*-filled.pdf and no contact sheet -- only field census, classification, fact fixtures, source record, findings and handoff. The lane disclosed the blocker, claimed no fill and did not modify the source, which is the correct handling. One correction to the index's phrasing: the two fields carry no /RV entry -- the file contains zero /RV tokens, raw or in any decompressed stream. What pdf-lib refuses on is the AcroForm RichText flag, /Ff bit 26, and both fields carry Ff 41947136 with that bit set. A fix that only looked for /RV would miss this family.
findings.likelyOwner: shared factory (D0), scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs -- outside the three defects this cycle authorized
findings.acceptanceCondition: Unchanged in substance from the correction index: sanitizeAndFlatten must finalize a document containing rich-text-flagged AcroForm fields without throwing -- by clearing the RichText flag on fields it does not write, or by updating appearances per field and skipping rich-text-flagged fields with a recorded refusal. Detect on the /Ff RichText bit, not on /RV. Acceptance: the D3A lane emits canonical, boundary and negative fixtures for MO CR-145; each is byte-inspectable with zero active-content residue; 'Other Defendants' and 'Address at Time of Arrest' are blank in all three; and the hold d0_factory_cannot_finalize_rich_text_acroform is removed from productionHolds. This requires the scope decision the cycle deferred; it is not a defect in lane D3A's work.
findings.evidenceBasis: git diff of the family directory between D3A's pre-correction head b1cac44fb5a170caca38394a3c520a70cc9efc01 and the correction branch head returned empty; listed the family tree at the correction head and confirmed no filled PDF exists; hashed the pack source and matched the recorded sha256; enumerated the AcroForm field tree with pypdf and found the RichText Ff bit on exactly the two named fields and zero /RV tokens anywhere in the file; and executed sanitizeAndFlatten from the correction branch worktree against those bytes and captured the throw.

families.rationale: The family-specific defect is fixed and independently verified against the PDF bytes. This reviewer rebuilt the withheld-field detector from scratch -- source AcroForm widget census by fully-qualified name, then text extracted from page content at each widget's own rectangle -- and it reproduces exactly 4 leaks on the pre-correction bytes, matching this family's recorded correction count, and 0 on the corrected bytes across canonical and boundary. Widening the same test to all 4 withheld fields and every other lane-refused field found no value written at any refused rectangle in either fixture, protected-category fields included. Nothing legitimate was lost: every character the untouched source's page content draws survives into both fixtures, page count, order and geometry are preserved, and every bound participant value is still visible at its own rectangle. No print-flag ink leak: every non-printing widget rectangle carries only what the source itself prints there or what an overlapping printing widget covers. The artifacts and the contact sheet are fully inspectable with no object streams and no encryption, and an independent scan of the materialised object model plus every decompressed stream found no XFA, JavaScript, field or document /AA, OpenAction, Launch, SubmitForm, ImportData or URI -- against 96 such objects in the pre-correction contact sheet, so defect B cleaned this family too even though a sheet defect was never recorded against it. Determinism was verified first hand rather than read off a report: re-running the lane from the verified source pack in a detached worktree reproduced all three artifacts byte-identically. Currentness and legal-design holds are unchanged. One moderate finding is recorded against the refusal-evidence artifacts; it is a consequence of the fix the correction index prescribed, it does not affect the artifacts, and it is owned by D0 rather than this lane. technical_approved is a technical-track disposition only -- this family still carries its visual-review, runtime and generation holds.
